//: THE CONTRACT TARIFF (docs/PLAN_demons.md D5; game/contract.h Weigh). A contract's WEIGHT is added to the demon's power when it is presented and when the bound demon is released: it binds iff circle strength >= power + weight. Every number is an integer; the editor (ui/contract_ui.cpp) shows the sum live, one line per term. A plain 2-wide salt ring of radius 1.5 m is ~36 points and an imp is power 20, so the stock pages (contracts.json) weigh 8..13 and fit a plain ring with room.
//term: The TERM, in game hours: a term of h hours costs the first bracket whose `hours` >= h (longer than the last: the last). `indefinite` (hours 0) is dear on purpose.
//duty: Each DUTY's base weight (follow / guard / goto / fetch / spin).
//forbid: Each PROHIBITION's base weight: a hard filter the binding enforces, so it is expensive.
//penalty: A PENALTY is cheap: the act it watches costs `penalty`, its consequence `then` (D6 makes the demon weigh it).
//selector: BREADTH points per selector term: a clause about everyone costs more than one about you. Multiplied by breadthPct (per clause kind, percent) into weight.
//perCondition: Each `when` condition and each named counter.
//upkeepPerPowerPct: UPKEEP: a bound demon reserves power x this / 100 of its summoner's mana max for as long as it is bound (an imp, power 20: 20 of 100).
